entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Docs: replace Pomelo with Microting #39734
  • EF Core 11 regression: A nested JSON complex collection projection with identity resolution is rejected #39733
  • Contradicting documentation: does EF Core 11 require .NET 11 or 10? #39732
  • EF Core 11: Full-text index with UseLanguage is re-diffed on every migration (drop + recreate) #39731

Closed

  • EFCore Delete And Add will merge to Update, and throw NullReferenceException #34274
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Implement EF.Functions.IsJson #39749
    community-contribution
  • Translate more DateOnly/TimeOnly members on SQLite #39748
    community-contribution
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39747
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39746
  • Translate TimeSpan members and operators on SQLite #39739
    community-contribution
  • Preserve init-only field assignments in ReplacingExpressionVisitor #39738
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Preserve added owned references during tracking queries #39736
  • Fix First warning detection for unrelated outer null checks #39735
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp and Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Workspaces #39741
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle from 2.6.1 to 2.7.0 #39744
    area-infrastructure

    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39737
  • [release/10.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.20.1 to 1.21.0 #39724
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.20.1 to 1.21.0 #39743
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26555.108 to 11.0.0-beta.26569.5 #39742
    area-infrastructure
  • Use the update sproc when a delete and insert are merged into an update #39727
    community-contribution
  • Update versions in DailyBuild.md. #39740

Updated

  • [release/10.0]: Bump StyleCop.Analyzers from 1.1.118 to 1.3.180 #39725
    area-infrastructure
